newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Danu Bank Q3 net up 20.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Thai Danu Bank Q3 net up 20.6 pct.

text.p: Thai Danu Bank Plc said on Monday the bank's unaudited net profit during the third quarter from July to September rose 20.6 percent to 271.17 million baht ($10.8 million) from a year earlier.
The bank's total assets at the end of September were 114.88 billion baht, or 42.2 percent, higher than at the end of last September, Thai Danu Bank said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Thai Danu Bank did not give the revenue figures for the third quarter or the net profit for the nine-month period.
